title: Howrah Bridge by day
author: rajaraman sundaram
attribution_text: Photo: rajaraman sundaram · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Cantilever span and towers of Howrah Bridge in daylight. Original 4608x3456; downloaded Wikimedia 1920 px rendition. Cropped to 16:9 (vertical anchor 0.3) and resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: landmark (the file's Panoramio coordinates sit about 4 km away and were not used).

title: Howrah Bridge at night
author: Dr. Moumita Sahana
attribution_text: Photo: Dr. Moumita Sahana · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Illuminated Howrah Bridge reflected in the Hooghly; a few tiny, unrecognisable silhouettes on the walkway. Original 5664x2752; downloaded Wikimedia 3840 px rendition. Cropped to 16:9 at full height (horizontal anchor 0.2) and resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: from the Commons file.

title: Vidyasagar Setu
author: Biswarup Ganguly
attribution_text: Photo: Biswarup Ganguly · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Cable-stayed Vidyasagar Setu across the Hooghly by day. Original 5691x3784; downloaded Wikimedia 1920 px rendition. Cropped to 16:9 (vertical anchor 0.5) and resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: landmark.

title: Victoria Memorial at night
author: DeepanjanGhosh
attribution_text: Photo: DeepanjanGhosh · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Elevated night view of the illuminated Victoria Memorial and its gardens; no people visible. Original 6704x3771; downloaded Wikimedia 1920 px rendition. Already close to 16:9; centred crop and resize; metadata stripped. Coordinates: from the Commons file (camera position).

title: Park Street lights at dusk
author: Amartyabag
attribution_text: Photo: Amartyabag · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Festive light canopy over Park Street at dusk with motion-blurred yellow taxis; plates not legible. Original 1600x1200 (downloaded original). Cropped to 16:9 (vertical anchor 0.35); metadata stripped. Coordinates: landmark.

title: Chowringhee Road at dusk
author: Paul Hamilton
attribution_text: Photo: Paul Hamilton · CC BY-SA 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Chowringhee Road looking south at dusk: traffic, street lights and buildings; pedestrians small and blurred. Original 3187x2205 (downloaded original). Edge crop: kept the right 78% (horizontal anchor 1.0, vertical 0.4) to drop a political poster at the left edge; then resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: Esplanade landmark (camera position on Chowringhee not recorded).

title: Yellow Ambassador taxis on Howrah Bridge
author: Pradip paswan
attribution_text: Photo: Pradip paswan · CC0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Yellow Ambassador taxis in evening traffic on Howrah Bridge; no front or rear plates visible. Original 6960x4640; downloaded Wikimedia 1920 px rendition. Cropped to 16:9 (vertical anchor 0.45) and resized; the painted taxi number on the nearest taxi's door stripe was painted over with the stripe colour; metadata stripped. Coordinates: Howrah Bridge landmark (location from the file description).

title: Heritage trams
author: Vyacheslav Argenberg
attribution_text: Photo: Vyacheslav Argenberg · CC BY 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Weathered blue Calcutta Tramways cars on route 6 (Shyambazar to BBD Bag) at a terminus. Original 4032x2688; downloaded Wikimedia 3840 px rendition. Edge crop: kept the left 71% (horizontal anchor 0, vertical 0.45) to drop the tram conductor's face at the right edge, along with a kiosk and posters; then resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: city centre (exact location not recorded).

title: Prinsep Ghat
author: Ushnish Jana
attribution_text: Photo: Ushnish Jana · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Prinsep Memorial colonnade beneath the Vidyasagar Setu pylons; a few small, unrecognisable passers-by. Original 4800x2700; downloaded Wikimedia 1920 px rendition. Already 16:9; resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: from the Commons file.

title: Hooghly ferry
author: Subhrajyoti07
attribution_text: Photo: Subhrajyoti07 · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Passenger ferry M.V. Kasturi crossing the Hooghly, seen from Nimtala Ghat; no people visible. Original 5556x2190; downloaded Wikimedia 3840 px rendition. Cropped to 16:9 at full height (horizontal anchor 0.385) and resized; the vessel registration number on the hull was blurred; metadata stripped. Coordinates: from the Commons file (camera position).

title: Eden Gardens
author: Chippu Abraham from Gurgaon, India
attribution_text: Photo: Chippu Abraham from Gurgaon, India · CC BY-SA 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Empty Eden Gardens cricket ground with stands and floodlight towers. Original 3008x2000; downloaded Wikimedia 1920 px rendition. Cropped to 16:9 (vertical anchor 0.4) and resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: landmark.

title: Salt Lake Stadium (Yuva Bharati Krirangan)
author: Vinayaraj
attribution_text: Photo: Vinayaraj · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Exterior of the Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan bowl with landscaped forecourt. Original 4608x3456; downloaded Wikimedia 1920 px rendition. Edge crop: 89% box anchored left and low (horizontal 0, vertical 0.8) to cut empty sky and drop a bystander's head at the right edge; then resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: landmark.

title: Biswa Bangla Gate, New Town
author: DeepanjanGhosh
attribution_text: Photo: DeepanjanGhosh · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Biswa Bangla Gate at night with long-exposure traffic light trails. Original 6474x4316; downloaded Wikimedia 1920 px rendition. Cropped to 16:9 (vertical anchor 0.4) and resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: from the Commons file.

title: Science City
author: Biswarup Ganguly
attribution_text: Photo: Biswarup Ganguly · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Science City dome, ropeway and maze garden; visitors small and incidental. Original 4288x2848; downloaded Wikimedia 1920 px rendition. Edge crop: 92% box anchored at the top to drop nearer visitors at the bottom edge; then resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: landmark.

title: Red Road
author: Biswarup Ganguly
attribution_text: Photo: Biswarup Ganguly · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Wide, tree-lined Red Road (Indira Gandhi Sarani) with light traffic; plates not legible. Original 4288x2848; downloaded Wikimedia 1920 px rendition. Cropped to 16:9 (vertical anchor 0.5) and resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: landmark.

title: Howrah Station from the river
author: Bernard Gagnon
attribution_text: Photo: Bernard Gagnon · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Red-brick towers and clock tower of Howrah Station seen across the Hooghly from Howrah Bridge. Original 5091x2005; downloaded Wikimedia 3840 px rendition. Edge crop: full-height 16:9 box anchored left (horizontal 0.08) to drop people bathing at the ghat on the right edge; then resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: from the Commons file (camera position).

title: Sealdah Station facade
author: Biswarup Ganguly
attribution_text: Photo: Biswarup Ganguly · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Main facade of Sealdah Station with its name boards, clock and departures board. Original 3648x2736 (downloaded original). Edge crop: 85% box anchored at the top (horizontal 0.6) so only the facade is shown and the crowd at the entrance below is excluded; then resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: landmark.

title: Kolkata Metro train
author: Ravi Dwivedi
attribution_text: Photo: Ravi Dwivedi · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: A Kolkata Metro rake arriving at the elevated Baranagar station; platform figures are distant specks. Original 4000x3000; downloaded Wikimedia 1920 px rendition. Cropped to 16:9 (vertical anchor 0.4) and resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: from the Commons file (Baranagar station).

title: Durga Puja pandal
author: VedSutra
attribution_text: Photo: VedSutra · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: A themed Durga Puja pandal sculpted as a giant head; architecture is the subject, visitors at the entrance are small. Original 5472x3080; downloaded Wikimedia 1920 px rendition. Edge crop: 86% box anchored left (vertical 0.3) to drop a group of visitors at the right edge; then resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: city centre (pandal location not recorded).

title: Clay idols at Kumartuli
author: Pinakpani
attribution_text: Photo: Pinakpani · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Unpainted clay idols (Ganesha, Lakshmi, Saraswati) in a Kumartuli workshop lane; no people. Original 4128x3096; downloaded Wikimedia 1920 px rendition. Cropped to 16:9 (vertical anchor 0.4) and resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: Kumartuli landmark.

title: Waterlogged street, Sector V
author: Biswarup Ganguly
attribution_text: Photo: Biswarup Ganguly · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Monsoon waterlogging on a Sector V, Salt Lake road with a bus and yellow taxis wading through; plates not legible. Original 2048x1536; downloaded Wikimedia 1920 px rendition. Cropped to 16:9 (vertical anchor 0.6) and resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: Sector V landmark (location from the file title).

title: The Hooghly at dusk
author: Alexey Komarov
attribution_text: Photo: Alexey Komarov · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
notes: Sunset over the Hooghly with a moored country boat, barges and the Vidyasagar Setu in the distance; no people. Original 5951x3967; downloaded Wikimedia 1920 px rendition. Cropped to 16:9 (vertical anchor 0.5) and resized; metadata stripped. Coordinates: from the Commons file.
